verdict.rationale: Callbacks on job completion are a fair question for a conversion API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a registrable callback URL or webhook for finished jobs; the items cover API keys, the CLI, wrappers, OCR, pricing and formats. The probes also found no OpenAPI spec that might have shown one.

support.subject: As a developer, finished jobs notify my system by callback instead of making me poll
